title: Wardstones
description: A special block that prevents hostile mobs from spawning in its vicitnity
body:
Have you ever wanted to protect your base from those pesky hostile mob spawns without placing torches all over your property? Then this mod is for you.

Introducing _Wardstones_, a mystical solution to all your mob spawn protection needs, these new blocks reliably prevent monsters from spawning in a fixed radius.

## Features
- Three different tiered blocks, each tier having increased range over its predecessor
- Effect ranges can be configured for each tier by editing the mod's configuration
- Works on both singleplayer worlds and on servers
